_readme: One entry per artwork. Fill in photo (file name in /assets/art/, without extension), size, woods, year, price and stripe (a Stripe Payment Link) as they arrive. A work with a stripe link shows a Buy button; without one it shows Enquire. Works without a photo show an empty slot while SHOW_PENDING is on in gen_art.py.

collections.name: Portraits
collections.blurb: Faces built from grain: every shadow and highlight is a different veneer.

collections.name: Abstract
collections.blurb: Spirals, ripples and flowing lines that follow the movement of the wood itself.

collections.name: Bismillah
collections.blurb: Calligraphy and sacred geometry set in contrasting natural woods.

works.title: Jesus Christ
works.description: A timeless depiction of Jesus Christ, meticulously crafted from natural wood veneer, showcasing divine grace through intricate detailing and rich wood textures.

works.title: Mona Lisa
works.description: Prepare to be captivated by the iconic smile of the Mona Lisa, reimagined in a medium that echoes the elegance of the original masterpiece.

works.title: Bob Marley
works.description: Celebrate the legacy of Bob Marley with this beautifully crafted wood veneer artwork, blending natural wood tones with an iconic design.

works.title: Abstract Flow
works.description: Abstract Flow is a mesmerizing wood veneer artwork designed with organic, wave-like patterns that resemble the natural flow of topographic landscapes or tree rings.

works.title: Hero Spiral
works.description: Hero Spiral is a captivating wood veneer artwork featuring an intricate optical illusion design that draws the eye into its swirling vortex.
